summary: Comprehensive frontend-only E2E testing of the Manasa Skin Clinic React app on production URL. Verified Hero, Nav, Brand Logo, Trust Strip, About, Services (all 5 tabs), Results, Testimonials, Why, Instagram, FAQ, Contact, Booking form (WhatsApp deep-link) and Footer. All critical user flows work. Two issues found: (1) horizontal scroll on mobile 390px viewport (docW=472 vs winW=390 = 82px overflow), and (2) minor a11y console warnings about DialogTitle missing on mobile menu sheet.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal scroll overflow on 390px viewport — document.scrollWidth=472 vs window.innerWidth=390 (82px overflow). Explicit test requirement was 'no horizontal scroll'.

In the 4-column micro-badges row, the '★ 4.9' number and adjacent 'GOOGLE RATED' / 'TREATMENTS' labels visually overlap / collide on wide viewport (visible as 'GOOGLES RATED' overlap in screenshot). Numbers or labels exceed the column at some widths.
The '— Dr. Manasa' signature italic overlaps visually with the 'Now Consulting · Nizamabad' floating card (both anchored near bottom-left of portrait). Minor cosmetic overlap.

Clicking the Manasa logo scrolls the page up but stops at scrollY≈690 instead of 0 (because the #top anchor is at the top of the hero section which sits below the sticky header + hero_shell has min-height). Not fully scrolled to top as requested.
Console warning (x2): 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users'. Radix Sheet used without SheetTitle/VisuallyHidden.

issues: Micro trust badges (1000+ / MBBS / 12+ / ★ 4.9) overlap adjacent columns on ≥1920 viewport
Signature '— Dr. Manasa' overlaps the 'Now Consulting · Nizamabad' pill card
82px horizontal overflow enables horizontal scroll — likely caused by hero orbs, decorative numeral '01' or absolute-positioned floating cards extending past viewport

action_items: Fix mobile horizontal scroll: add overflow-x:hidden to body/main or constrain absolutely-positioned decorative elements in Hero (hero-orb, hero-num, g-card floating cards) with proper max-width or clip-path so they do not extend past viewport at 390px
Fix hero micro-badges overlap on wide desktop: use grid-cols-4 with min-width/gap or reduce the '★ 4.9' number font-size / column width so labels do not overflow into neighbor columns
Fix logo-to-top scroll: change nav-logo-link href from '#top' to scroll to y=0 (onClick handler with window.scrollTo({top:0}) ) since #top anchor sits below the sticky nav header
Fix a11y warning: wrap SheetContent's first child with a SheetTitle (visually hidden via VisuallyHidden or sr-only class) — e.g., <SheetTitle className='sr-only'>Menu</SheetTitle>
Consider adjusting '— Dr. Manasa' signature position or the 'Now Consulting · Nizamabad' floating card so they don't overlap
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx uses many absolute-positioned decorative elements (orbs, numeral, g-cards) without a parent overflow:hidden, causing 82px horizontal overflow on mobile — should be scoped by overflow-hidden on .hero-shell
Nav.jsx uses Radix Sheet without SheetTitle causing accessibility violations. Add a visually-hidden SheetTitle

Contact.jsx booking form does not sanitize/validate phone or email formats client-side; also date input defaults to browser native picker (which is fine but not the shadcn calendar — acceptable per PRD)
App.js: reveal IntersectionObserver only runs once on mount; components added dynamically after mount won't be observed. Minor since site is static SPA
All data-testid attributes properly present and coverage is excellent
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
context_for_next_testing_agent: First iteration complete. All flows verified working. Main functional bugs: (1) mobile horizontal scroll (~82px), (2) hero micro-badges overlap on wide desktop, (3) logo doesn't fully scroll to top, (4) Radix Sheet a11y warning. All test-ids from PRD verified present and working. Booking form opens WhatsApp popup correctly (URL redirects wa.me -> api.whatsapp.com/send with phone=916305544765) and success state renders. All 5 Services tabs switch content correctly (Skin=7, Hair=4, Aesthetic=5, Nail=3, Laser&Surgical=10 cards). FAQ multi-open works. Zero desktop console errors. Test the same flows after fixes are applied.

mobile_horizontal_scroll.reproduction: Set viewport 390x844, load page. document.documentElement.scrollWidth = 472 > window.innerWidth = 390.
mobile_horizontal_scroll.likely_cause: Hero.jsx uses fixed-width absolute-positioned elements: hero-orb (520px / 380px), hero-num (huge decorative '01'), floating g-cards positioned with negative left/right offsets (left:-8%, right:-14%). Without overflow-x:hidden on parent, they push document width past viewport at small widths.
mobile_horizontal_scroll.mitigation: Add overflow-x:hidden (or clip-path: inset(0)) to .hero-shell and/or body. Alternatively constrain the orbs and floating cards with responsive positioning.

logo_scroll_top.reproduction: Scroll to footer, click nav-logo-link, page scrolls to y=690 not y=0
logo_scroll_top.likely_cause: Anchor href='#top' targets the hero section id='top' whose top edge is below the sticky nav header offset; browser scroll-to-anchor accounts for scroll-margin.
logo_scroll_top.mitigation: Replace with onClick={e => { e.preventDefault(); window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'}); }}
